summary: Tested photo base64 storage fix for production persistence. All backend APIs (12/12 tests) and frontend functionality working correctly. Photos are now stored as base64 in MongoDB and served via /api/photos/ endpoint, ensuring persistence across deployments.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded test photos during testing - stored with base64 in database
context_for_next_testing_agent: Photo base64 storage is working correctly. New photos uploaded via POST /api/projects/{id}/first-visit/photos and POST /api/projects/{id}/designs are stored with base64_data in MongoDB and served via GET /api/photos/{file_type}/{project_id}/{filename}. Old photos (without base64) fall back to file system serving via /api/static/ endpoint.

POST /api/projects/{id}/first-visit/phot.details: Uploads photo, stores base64 in database, returns /api/photos/ URL

POST /api/projects/{id}/designs.details: Uploads design, stores base64 for images <10MB, returns /api/photos/designs/ URL

GET /api/photos/first_visit/{project_id}.details: Serves photo from database base64 with correct content-type

GET /api/photos/designs/{project_id}/{fi.details: Serves design from database base64 with correct content-type

Fallback to file system.details: Old photos without base64 are served from file system

Frontend: First Visit tab.details: Shows 17 photos in 8 folders with room organization

Frontend: 3D Ontwerpen tab.details: Shows 10 designs in 7 folders with room organization

Customer Portal: Photos visible.details: All 17 first visit photos displayed in grid, images loading correctly

ui_verification.admin_login: PASS - Admin login with username/password works correctly
ui_verification.project_navigation: PASS - Can navigate to project detail page
ui_verification.customer_portal_photos: PASS - All photos load correctly in grid

implementation_notes.storage_mechanism: Photos stored as base64 string in MongoDB document (first_visit_photos array or design_3d_files array)
implementation_notes.backward_compatibility: Old photos without base64_data fall back to file system serving
implementation_notes.production_note: Existing photos need to be re-uploaded to get base64 storage for production persistence
